text: Being here, I am reminded of the intersection between formality and creativity—the glass walls suggest boundaries, while the room beyond feels open and expectant, ready for purposeful encounter. The second space radiates energy, the colors and the "R+D" promise curiosity, innovation, and perhaps intellectual play. I feel slightly disoriented by the angles, as if my physical orientation reflects the mind’s inclination to tiptoe at the edge of discovery. Here, I am both observer and actor in a world of evolving knowledge.
